notes: Added missing schema/contract, core routing flow, API integration, and test coverage stories for FEAT-5.

stories.title: Tool Schema Registration and Pydantic Contract Binding
stories.description: Define and register all allowed tools with explicit Pydantic schemas, ensuring each tool has a strict input contract mapped in the router for validation prior to execution.

stories.title: Core Tool Routing Execution Flow
stories.description: Implement the end-to-end routing flow that parses tool_use blocks, validates against allowlist, applies Pydantic validation, and dispatches to the correct domain service or facade.

stories.title: FastAPI Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool dispatch is invoked within the agent loop and properly handles chat history and tool responses.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Routing
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure, tool dispatch correctness, and error handling paths.
